title: Rhythm
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Creative Arts; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Clap and say the French names; write notes on the board as words and drawings. Count the beat aloud.

skills.key_step: The child says a crotchet is one beat, a pair of quavers one beat together, and rests are silent beats that are counted.

floor.prerequisite: Knows a half of a whole.
floor.question: Two halves make how many wholes?

steps: Crotchet: one clap on one beat.
Pair of quavers: two quick claps in one beat.
contexts: clapping a pattern for a song

board.do: How many claps fit in one beat with quavers?

misconceptions.ask: How many beats do a pair of quavers last together?
misconceptions.repair: Clap one crotchet, then clap two quick claps in the same beat.

misconceptions.ask: A crotchet rest comes in a pattern. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Clap taa, rest, taa while counting 1 2 3 out loud.

misconceptions.ask: What do you do at a rest?
misconceptions.repair: Clap the pattern and hold open hands at the rest.

misconceptions.ask: How long is a quaver rest?
misconceptions.repair: Match each rest to the note of the same length.

checks.question: How many beats does a crotchet rest last?
How long does one quaver last?

skills.key_step: The child matches taa to a crotchet and ta-te to a pair of quavers, and keeps silent for rests.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the beats of a crotchet and a pair of quavers.
floor.question: How many beats does a pair of quavers last?

contexts: saying the rhythm of a school song

misconceptions.repair: Say ta-te as you tap one beat once.

misconceptions.ask: Which name is for a crotchet?
misconceptions.repair: Say taa slowly and ta-te quickly and tap the beats.

misconceptions.ask: What do you say aloud at a rest?
misconceptions.repair: Chant taa, rest, taa and hold the rest in silence.

misconceptions.ask: What do you say for a crotchet rest?
misconceptions.repair: Clap a pattern and hold hands apart for the rest.

checks.question: What is the French name for a crotchet?

skills.key_step: The child names what makes a good rhythm: a steady beat, a clear repeated idea, some variety and a firm ending.

floor.question: Say the rhythm taa ta-te taa taa.

representations: two patterns clapped by the teacher
contexts: making a rhythm for a class song
a rhythm for a sports cheer

board.do: The one with the repeated idea.

misconceptions.repair: Clap both and ask which is more interesting.

listen_for: It makes the pattern boring and wrong
misconceptions.ask: What does repetition do in a pattern?
misconceptions.repair: Clap a tune that repeats a short part and ask if it is easy to remember.

misconceptions.ask: A good rhythmic pattern ends on...
misconceptions.repair: Clap one ending on a short sound and one on a long sound.

misconceptions.ask: Which is better: a pattern that repeats a clear idea, or one that is very long and never repeats?
misconceptions.repair: Clap both; ask which one the class can remember.

checks.question: Name one quality of a good rhythm.
checks.answer: any of: steady beat, a repeated idea, variety, a firm ending

checks.question: Is a pattern of only crotchets the most interesting?

skills.key_step: The child tells ascenders (b, d, h, l, t) from descenders (g, p, y) and keeps small letters between guide lines.

floor.question: Which is a capital: t or T?

representations: four guide lines on the board
steps: Small letters stay in the middle.
Ascenders go up; descenders go down.
contexts: writing rhythm names on a chart

board.say: Does it go up or down?

misconceptions.repair: Write the letters on a ruled line and see which go below it.
Draw a line and write b above and p below it.
Write the word "ace" and look for letters that go neither up nor down.

misconceptions.ask: In free hand lettering, is "a" as tall as "T"?
misconceptions.repair: Rule four guide lines and write a, t, g on them.

checks.question: Is "t" an ascender or a descender?
Name a descender.
checks.answer: any of: g, p, q, y, j
